_README: Known-wrong reading-text pairs — tried on EVERY verse by verify-reading-glosses.mjs (the parallel gate), including verses with no Hebrew tokens. A pair 'word (gloss)' is a violation when word matches and the gloss contains one of gloss_words, unless THAT verse's own Hebrew has the word's root. strongs-renumber.json entries with raw_root + gloss_words (ashah→woman/wife, bath→daughter) are added automatically — do not repeat them here. Add a line whenever fieldy finds a new one.
